findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes. Second reading, final passage
findings.note: Representative Dennis Riddell's votes page on the NC General Assembly site lists this vote. The bill text cited is the Sixth Edition at the bill page; I did not confirm that edition is the one voted on in each case. The bill changes voter-ID and absentee rules, including the deadline to bring photo ID after a provisional ballot (third business day moved to fifth business day), ID checks for absentee ballots, and a rule on voters whose ID numbers do not match. Roll call shows Aye on this motion. Source for the bill text: https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v6.pdf
